title: Listen and Choose a Response — Workplace

questions.stem: I left my lunch on the kitchen counter at home.

options.A: I left the office early yesterday.
options.B: There's a sandwich shop downstairs if you want.
options.C: The kitchen counter is made of stone.
options.D: I had a big lunch today.

questions.explanation: Suggesting a nearby shop is a helpful reply; the distractors repeat words from the statement.
